nodes.question: Why is Mass for autonomous vehicles considered unique in terms of accessibility, planning, and payment characteristics?
nodes.answer: Mass for autonomous vehicles is considered unique due to its advanced automated vehicles that can reduce automobile fleets and improve traffic congestion in heavily populated areas, as indicated by literature (Tarbat et al., 2018).
